risk.read: Only reads state; safe to run any time.
risk.change: Changes settings or UI state; reversible (config writes keep a backup).
risk.disruptive: Interrupts the session, locks or powers off the machine, or restarts the shell. Ask the user first.

commands.name: commands
commands.description: List every command with its usage and risk level (read, change or disruptive).

commands.name: share
commands.description: Export your setup (changed settings, themes, scenes, layouts) to one file with personal data left out, or preview and import someone else's. Import only previews unless --apply is given.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check why the shell may not run (settings, daemon, shell, log, services). --fix applies only safe repairs: restore a settings.json that does not parse, remove stale pid files.

commands.name: scene
commands.description: Switch named bundles of settings (do not disturb, autohide, theme, screen warmth...) by hand or automatically by focused app and time.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Install the Taurus AI agent skills into Claude Code and ~/.agents/skills, remove them, or show their state.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show the current state of a setting, and the install, state, log and config paths.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Read and change settings.json. Writes make a backup first; reset restores the shipped default; diff shows what you changed.

commands.name: set
commands.usage: set <notifications dnd|idle caffeine|dock <enabled|autohide>|sfx mute> [on|off|toggle] | set theme <preset <name>|matugen [on|off|toggle]|app <id> [on|off|toggle]> | set lang <code> | set wallpaper <value> [screen]
commands.description: Change a setting (notifications, idle, dock, sfx, theme, lang, wallpaper).

commands.name: trigger
commands.description: Run a one-off action (idle, notifications, theme, firstlaunch).

commands.name: msg
commands.description: Dispatch commands or workspace switches to the UI manager (open, toggle or close panels).

commands.name: settings
commands.description: Open the settings window, optionally on a given tab.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Launch standalone components (start).

commands.name: ipc
commands.description: Forward IPC calls directly to the shell.

commands.name: kill
commands.description: Cleanly stop the running daemon.

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Stop and start the daemon again.

commands.name: exit
commands.description: Terminate graphical session and exit compositor.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Activate the lockscreen interface.

commands.name: suspend
commands.description: Lock the screen and suspend the system.

commands.name: hibernate
commands.description: Hibernate the system.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboot the system.

commands.name: poweroff
commands.description: Power off the system.

commands.name: redactor
commands.description: Open or toggle the desktop widget layout editor.

commands.name: lock-redactor
commands.description: Toggle, open or close the lock screen layout editor.

commands.name: volume
commands.description: Control default audio sink/source volume and mute states.

commands.name: brightness
commands.description: Adjust backlight display brightness.

commands.name: reload
commands.description: Force reload quickshell desktop elements.

commands.name: weather
commands.description: Fetch and manage weather forecast data and caches.

commands.name: location
commands.description: Retrieve and update geographic coordinates.

commands.name: location_manual
commands.description: Set geographic coordinates and timezone manually.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.description: Capture screen images, record video, or parse QR codes.

commands.name: colorpicker
commands.description: Pick a color from the screen and copy it to the clipboard.

commands.name: gamma
commands.description: Adjust color temperature and automatic day/night schedule.
